title: EGA VI. Plans, notations, problèmes ouverts : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a notation sheet for the planned EGA VI, the part on Hilbert, Quot, Picard and Hom schemes. The previous page lists that chapter's planned contents and the next page begins the 'Problèmes ouverts'. Grothendieck fixes a three-level typographical convention, illustrated throughout the page with base change S'→S, X' = X×_S S', F' the pull-back of F:
- A doubly underlined symbol (e.g. Quot_{F/X/S}, Hilb_{X/S}, Div_{X/S}, Hom_S(X,Y), Isom_S(X,Y), Aut_S(X), Imm_S(X,Y)) is the functor on S-schemes, or the S-scheme representing it.
- A singly underlined symbol (Quot(F'/X'/S'), Hom_{S'}(X',Y'), …) is the corresponding sheaf on S'.
- A plain symbol is the set of its global sections.
So Quot_{F/X/S}(S') = Γ(S', Quot(F'/X'/S')) = Quot(F'/X'/S'), and Hilb_{X/S} = Quot_{O_X/X/S}. Similarly Hom_S(X,Y)(S') = Hom_{S'}(X',Y') = Hom_S(X×_S S', Y). Isom, Aut and Imm (immersions) follow the same pattern.

The Weil restriction (∏_{Y/S} X/Y)(S') = Γ(X'/Y'), the sections of X'→Y'. It is alternatively denoted Γ_{Y/S}(X/Y) = H^0_{Y/S}(X/Y), i.e. the scheme of sections viewed as a non-abelian H^0.

Picard is treated in three stages:
- Prépic_{X/S}(S') = H^1(X', O*_{X'}) is a presheaf.
- Prépic'_{X/S}(S') = Γ(S', R^1f'_*O*), labelled 'faisceau'.
- Pic_{X/S} is the associated (fppf) sheaf, written Pic_{X/S}(S') = Pic(X'/S'), and equated to the sheafified Prépic.
This is the FGA/Bourbaki 232 hierarchy of relative Picard functors.

Item 2 is the linear theory of EGA III §7.7. For f: X→S (proper, F coherent and flat over S), the functor M ↦ H^0(X, F⊗_{O_S} M) is represented by a coherent O_S-module ∏_{X/S}F, contravariant in F: Hom(∏_{X/S}F, M) = H^0(F⊗_S M). A sheafified version holds with H^0_{X/S} = f_*. Correspondingly V(∏_{X/S}F) = ∏_{X/S} V(F): the Weil restriction of the vector bundle V(F) is the linear scheme V of that module.

More generally Hom_{X/S}(F,G) is the coherent O_S-module with Hom(Hom_{X/S}(F,G), M) = Hom_{O_X}(F, G⊗_{O_S} M). Its sheafified version is Hom_{O_S}(Hom_{X/S}(F,G), M) = f_*Hom(F, G⊗M). Base change gives Hom(Hom_{X/S}(F,G)⊗S', O_{S'}) = Hom_{O_{X'}}(F',G'), so V(Hom_{X/S}(F,G)) represents S' ↦ Hom(F',G'). Grothendieck crossed out an attempt to write Hom_{X/S}(F,G)(S') in functor style. His note 'Notation opératoire ???' records the clash: the doubly underlined Hom is here a module, contravariant in F, not a functor of points.

The margin letters F, X, Y index which datum each object is attached to, apparently for the boxed 'Notations' table.
errors: The queried formula V(∏_{X/S}F) = Hom_{X/S}(F, O_X) '?' is wrong as written. By the page's own definitions, Hom(Hom_{X/S}(O_X,F), M) = Hom(O_X, F⊗M) = H^0(F⊗M), so ∏_{X/S}F = Hom_{X/S}(O_X, F), not Hom_{X/S}(F, O_X). Grothendieck flagged it with a question mark and crossed it partially.

Representability formulas such as Hom(∏F, M) = H^0(F⊗M) need the hypotheses of EGA III 7.7.6 (f proper, F coherent and S-flat, S locally noetherian). These are not stated here, which is acceptable for a notation sheet.
'Pic_{X/S} = Prépic_{X/S}(…S')' is only meaningful if the right side means the associated sheaf. Pic(X'/S') ≠ H^1(X', O*) in general without a section and sheafification.

ideas.what: Systematic double/single/plain underline convention for functor (or scheme), relative sheaf, and global sections, applied to Quot, Hilb, Div, Hom, Isom, Aut, Imm
ideas.modern_name: Functor of points / representing scheme notation for moduli schemes
ideas.where_published: FGA (Bourbaki exposés 221, 232); EGA I (1971 ed.) and EGA IV notational conventions

ideas.what: Weil restriction as scheme of sections, denoted ∏_{Y/S} X/Y = Γ_{Y/S}(X/Y) = H^0_{Y/S}(X/Y)
Prépic (presheaf H^1(X',O*)), Prépic' (Γ(S', R^1f_*O*)), Pic (associated sheaf)
ideas.modern_name: Relative Picard functors: absolute, Zariski/étale-sheafified, fppf

ideas.what: Coherent module ∏_{X/S}F = Hom_{X/S}(O_X,F) representing M ↦ H^0(F⊗M), and Hom_{X/S}(F,G) representing M ↦ Hom(F, G⊗M); V of these gives the linear Hom schemes
ideas.modern_name: Cohomology-and-base-change representability (EGA III 7.7.6, 7.7.8–7.7.9); linear Hom scheme

deep.surprise_reason: This is a notation sheet for EGA VI. All the objects (Quot, Hilb, Hom/Isom/Aut, Weil restriction, the Prépic/Pic hierarchy, the EGA III 7.7 representing modules) are published in FGA and EGA. The only unpublished items are the notational hesitations ('Notation opératoire ???') and a self-flagged slip.
transcription_corrections: In the Div line the crossed-out letters after 'Div' are illegible scribbles. 'eff' is a guess; the image shows heavy strike-through, not clearly 'eff'.
The queried formula reads '(V)(∏_{X/S}F) = Hom_{X/S}(F, O_X)' with a circled/crossed V and a question mark, and is boxed together with 'Notation opératoire ???'.

The last bracketed formula is Hom_{O_S}(Hom_{X/S}(F,G), M) = Hom_{X/S}(F, G⊗M), with the subscript O_S under the first Hom. The second underlined Hom has its subscript crossed out, not simply missing.
In the Prépic line, the inserted '= H^1(X', O*_{X'})' is written above the crossed-out text, which was an attempt like '= Γ(S', H^1 …)'.
Above Pic and Prépic' the labels are 'préfaisceau' (for Prépic) and 'faisceau' (for Prépic', and for H^1_{X'/S'}(O*)).
